title: mapPartitions vs map：函数调用次数对比
expected_output:
记录数 = 12, 分区数 = 3
map: 逐元素调用 -> 函数调用 12 次
mapPartitions: 逐分区调用 -> 函数调用 3 次
调用次数比 map : mapPartitions = 12 : 3 = 4 : 1
code:
data = list(range(12))
partitions = [data[0:4], data[4:8], data[8:12]]
map_calls = 0
def m(x):
    global map_calls
    map_calls += 1
    return x * 2
out_map = [m(x) for p in partitions for x in p]
mp_calls = 0
def mp(it):
    global mp_calls
    mp_calls += 1
    return [y * 2 for y in it]
out_mp = [y for p in partitions for y in mp(p)]
print(f"记录数 = {len(data)}, 分区数 = {len(partitions)}")
print(f"map: 逐元素调用 -> 函数调用 {map_calls} 次")
print(f"mapPartitions: 逐分区调用 -> 函数调用 {mp_calls} 次")
print(f"调用次数比 map : mapPartitions = {map_calls} : {mp_calls} = {map_calls // mp_calls} : 1")
